$comment: Hook file names the engine once shipped under hooks/ and has since renamed or removed, relative to hooks/ (e.g. "lib/git-event.sh"). sync-projects.py prunes these from every active checkout's .claude/hooks/ and .codex/hooks/, and drops any stale registration of them from .claude/settings.json and .codex/hooks.json. Append a name here whenever a hook file is renamed or removed; never remove an entry.
